# State Inflation Tracker. ## JEC Republicans State Inflation Tracker. ## Increased Costs Relative to January 2021 Prices. Click here for access to all of the underlying data. Inflation rates reflect how much prices have increased since January 2021, and inflation costs reflect how much more the average U.S. household must pay in the current month for the same goods and services it purchased in January 2021. See our methodology for a detailed explanation of these calculations. Click your state to view the latest inflation data.
